title: Chuunibyou demo Koi ga Shitai! Ren Lite
justification: AniList 20582 (ONA, 6 episode(s) from 2013-12-25) is AniDB 9874's special(s) S2-S7, aired 2013-12-26 to 2014-03-13. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 18671, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 9874, the titles 'Lite 1' to 'Lite 6' match the AniList title, and AniDB lists MAL 21797 on AniDB 9874. TVDB 261862 0x11-0x16 'Chunibyo Lite! 1' to '6' carry the same titles and dates within a day.
